consumer: The frontend status panel reads the snapshot's stamina/pain scalars to SHOW them to the player; no engine condition/mission/dialogue check consumes these for a yes/no.
scope: only the avatar's own status scalars (stamina, pain) as the GUI would display them; not a predicate result and not a map region
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) — writes ctx.u.get_stamina() and ctx.u.get_pain() straight from the engine getters into the snapshot JSON for the panel to render
divergence: A character whose perceived/displayed pain differs from raw get_pain() (e.g. pain masked or capped for the status display, or a stale snapshot after a turn advance) — the panel would show a value diverging from what the real GUI presents, exposing a wrong authority
